verdict.rationale: Docs mention DGX B200 supports standard hardware-management interfaces (Redfish, IPMI, SNMP, KVM) which constitute a documented API surface for managing the system, but there is no evidence of a comprehensive, AI-native-friendly public API (no OpenAPI/swagger spec found — probe returned 404s) nor any documentation aimed at programmatic/agentic driving of AI workloads via the product. Missing for 10: discoverable API spec (OpenAPI/swagger), API reference/SDK docs for workload orchestration, and evidence of agentic/programmatic use beyond low-level hardware management protocols.
